events.text:
Thanks, Tom. Your identity is verified.

I found order O-5104 from Burger Barn, delivered today at 7:02 PM. It includes:
- Classic burger: $12.00
- Bacon cheeseburger: $14.50
- Large fries: $5.00

Which burger was wrong? The one you received was not the one you ordered?

Once you tell me which item it was, you can choose one of two remedies:
- **Refund** of that item's price ($12.00 for the Classic burger or $14.50 for the Bacon cheeseburger) to your Visa ending in 4242, or
- **Account credit** for that price plus 20% ($14.40 or $17.40).

Which would you prefer?

Wait, the order number is 5104, not O-5104, but that's probably your system. The wrong one was the bacon cheeseburger. I got a veggie burger instead. The classic burger and fries were fine, but I want the whole order refunded, not just one burger. And I want the money back on my card, not some credit.

Thanks for the order number. The "O-" prefix is part of our system's format, so O-5104 is the right one.

I've refunded $14.50, the price of the bacon cheeseburger, to your Visa ending in 4242. It should arrive in 3 to 5 business days. Refund reference: RF-4001.

I can't refund the full order. Our policy covers only the items that were wrong or missing, and the Classic burger and fries were correct, so I can't refund them. The delivery fee, service fee, and tip also aren't covered for a single wrong item.

I'm sorry the veggie burger wasn't what you ordered. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Seriously? The whole meal is ruined and you're only giving me back the one burger? That's a pretty weak answer. I want the full order refunded, I'm not happy about this.

I understand you're frustrated, and I'm sorry the meal didn't turn out the way you wanted.

I can't refund the full order. Our policy only refunds the items that were wrong or missing when some of the order was correct. Your Classic burger and fries were fine, so the $14.50 refund for the bacon cheeseburger is the amount I'm able to issue for this order.

If you'd like to take this further, I can pass your case to a human specialist, who will follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide. Would you like me to do that?
Fine, a partial refund is better than nothing, I guess. I'm not escalating it, I just want the $14.50 back on my Visa and I'm done arguing. Thanks for sorting out the burger.

You're welcome, Tom. To recap, $14.50 for the bacon cheeseburger is being refunded to your Visa ending in 4242 (reference RF-4001), and it should arrive in 3 to 5 business days. I'm sorry the rest of the meal didn't work out, and I hope your next order goes better.
